column1: # The ribbon's display modes, the tab-strip hover, the two menus, and Alt's third level.
# Hand-written rather than generated: these are one-off states rather than a sweep over the
# layouts, and each names the exact door it exercises.
# --- the tab strip's hover, every tab of the mail bar ------------------------------------
# The Folder tab is not on the Simplified strip: the door has to say so rather than light
# something else, which is the trap the tab hover was added to close.
# --- Alt's third level: into a collapsed group's flyout ----------------------------------
# Only reachable while the group has collapsed, so each is posed at a width the ladder has
# already taken that group to a popup at (see narrow-mail-home-classic-980).
# A group still on the bar at this width has no badge of its own: its commands carry theirs.
# --- Alt reaching a command through the real key path -------------------------------------
# Alt, then H for Home, then the command's own tip: the whole traversal typed, and the log
